note: How a chart fact or a resolver decision is voiced (prose plan §3.2). Slots: {star} {stars} {branch} {hoa} {tt} (Tuần/Triệt) {dignity} {S}; {concept.np|pron|say} = the concept this move voices (say = pred for +/~ concepts, turn for − concepts, soft when softened); {target.np|pron} = the concept the move acts on; {value} {value2} {mature} for the closing moves. A card names facts and relations only; the trait comes from the concept card. Drafted by Claude 2026-10-18, review pending.
